title: Vision-Language Models Integrate Conflicting Evidence Like Biased Bayesian Observers
abstract: arXiv:2610.19407v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models must reconcile conflicting text and images. Prior work has characterized the resulting behavior in terms of modality biases--e.g., a "blind faith in text"--but why preferences vary across models, domains, and input conditions remains unclear. We develop a predictive account from a Bayesian perspective, positing that VLMs combine conditionally independent evidence from each modality with prior beliefs, subject to modality-specific biases. The resulting two-parameter cue combination model accurately predicts VLM preferences under unseen combinations of input degradation and transfers to new forms of unreliability without refitting. Separating evidence strength from integration bias explains how VLMs can follow text even while weighting visual evidence more heavily, reconciling reports of text and vision dominance under a single combination rule.

translated_title: 视觉-语言模型像有偏见的贝叶斯观察者一样整合冲突证据
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）必须协调冲突的文本与图像信息。先前的工作用模态偏差来刻画由此产生的行为——例如“对文本的盲目信任”——但这种偏好在不同模型、领域和输入条件下为何有所不同仍不清楚。我们从贝叶斯视角发展了一种预测性解释，假设VLM将来自各模态的条件独立证据与先验信念相结合，并受模态特定偏差的影响。由此得到的双参数线索组合模型能够准确预测VLM在未见过的输入退化组合下的偏好，并且无需重新拟合即可迁移到新形式的不可靠性。将证据强度与整合偏差分离可以解释VLM如何在更重视视觉证据的同时仍遵循文本，从而在单一组合规则下统一了关于文本主导和视觉主导的现象。
tldr: 本文提出一个贝叶斯视角的双参数线索组合模型，通过将证据强度与模态整合偏差分离，准确预测视觉-语言模型在冲突多模态输入下的偏好并无需重新拟合即可泛化到新的不可靠性形式，在单一规则下统一解释了文本主导与视觉主导现象。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-parameter Bayesian cue-combination model that separates evidence strength from modality-specific integration bias, accurately predicting VLM preferences under conflicting multimodal inputs, generalizing to new forms of unreliability without refitting, and unifying reports of both text and vision dominance under a single rule.
